nodes.name: 00_setup_infrastructure.md
nodes.summary: Agent prompt instructing a testing engineer to build the Vitest/RTL/MSW testing infrastructure: jsdom config, src/test/setup.ts with matchMedia and ResizeObserver mocks, a provider-wrapping custom render, and an MSW server.
